Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid),
		foundCards: Set(BankCard) = BankCard.allInstance()->select(o|o.CardID = cardid),
		cardExists: Boolean = (card.oclIsUndefined() = false)
	precondition:
		cardid>=0
	postcondition:
		InputCard = card and
		CardIDValidated = cardExists and
		result = cardExists
}
